ceu: ✦ The conjunction between the Sun and Venus

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.
Until {H:1817879742000}, the Moon is still in {S:7} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
s.d: Listen to a podcast or a talk on a new subject.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.
Until {H:1817879742000}, the Moon is still in {S:7} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on home and family. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
s.d: Write on a piece of paper what you want to be free of and tear it up.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
Until {H:1817879742000}, the Moon is still in {S:7} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
s.d: Clear up a misunderstanding with a calm conversation.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
Until {H:1817879742000}, the Moon is still in {S:7} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on your money and what you value. It is a good day to start something in this area.
s.d: Tidy your desk before you start.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.
Until {H:1817879742000}, the Moon is still in {S:7} and stirs up home and family.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on your image and your personal energy. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
s.d: Write something lovely about someone you care for.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.
Until {H:1817879742000}, the Moon is still in {S:7} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on rest and your inner life. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
s.d: Phone an older relative and listen to them without hurry.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.
Until {H:1817879742000}, the Moon is still in {S:7} and stirs up your money and what you value.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on friends and plans for the future. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
s.d: Learn a new word or a new thing today, out of curiosity.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.
Until {H:1817879742000}, the Moon is still in {S:7} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on your career and your goals. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
s.d: Cook a meal you love at home and savour it slowly.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.
Until {H:1817879742000}, the Moon is still in {S:7} and stirs up rest and your inner life.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
s.d: Keep away from people who drain your energy, even if only for a day.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.
Until {H:1817879742000}, the Moon is still in {S:7} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.
Until {H:1817879742000}, the Moon is still in {S:7} and stirs up your career and your goals.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on relationships and partnerships. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.
Until {H:1817879742000}, the Moon is still in {S:7} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on routine, daily work and health. A new beginning may be born from here.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.
